title: X-Schema
description: Declarative specification for rendering and editing structured object values in XShell.

root.description: Name of the root object type declared in types. The referenced type must exist; this is enforced by X-Schema semantic validation.

types.description: Named reusable or recursive object type definitions.

objectReference.description: Reference to a named object type. Properties declared on the reference override the corresponding defaults declared by the referenced object type.

type.description: Name of an object type declared in the top-level types registry. The referenced type must exist; this is enforced by X-Schema semantic validation.

required.description: Static required state for the bound value. A conditions.required rule, when present, dynamically overrides this value.

attrs.description: Context-specific attributes. Values override attributes with the same name declared by the referenced object type.

props.description: Context-specific component properties. Values override properties with the same name declared by the referenced object type.

conditions.description: Context-specific conditions. Conditions with the same name override conditions declared by the referenced object type.

create.description: Context-specific creation value. When present, overrides the create value declared by the referenced object type.

objectType.description: Named reusable object definition. Presentation and behavior properties declared here act as defaults for every reference to this type.

tag.description: Default DOM/Web Component tag used when rendering instances of this object type.

attrs.description: Default attributes inherited by references to this object type.

props.description: Default component properties inherited by references to this object type.

create.description: Default value used when creating an instance of this object type.

conditions.description: Default dynamic conditions inherited by references to this object type.

required.description: Static required state for the bound value. A conditions.required rule, when present, dynamically overrides this value.

create.description: Value used when creating or activating this object.

required.description: Static required state for the bound value. A conditions.required rule, when present, dynamically overrides this value.

default.description: Default value used when the bound value has not otherwise been initialized.

required.description: Static required state for the bound value. A conditions.required rule, when present, dynamically overrides this value.

item.description: Definition of each array item. Object references may be used for reusable or recursive object items.

default.description: Default array value used when the bound array has not otherwise been initialized.

containerNode.description: Presentation-only node used to compose child nodes. Containers do not establish a data binding context.

bind.description: Path relative to the current data context. Scoped paths may use $current, $parent or $root.

arrayOptions.description: Array editing behavior. When both minItems and maxItems are present, minItems must not exceed maxItems; this is enforced by X-Schema semantic validation.

conditions.description: Dynamic node-state rules. Missing positive conditions default to true; missing negative conditions default to false. Effective visibility is visible && !hidden. Effective enabled state is enabled && !disabled.

visible.description: Positive visibility condition. When absent, visibility defaults to true before applying hidden.

hidden.description: Negative visibility condition. When true, the node is hidden regardless of visible.

enabled.description: Positive enabled condition. When absent, enabled defaults to true before applying disabled.

disabled.description: Negative enabled condition. When true, the node is disabled regardless of enabled.

readonly.description: Condition controlling whether the node is read-only.

required.description: Condition that dynamically overrides the node's static required property.

pathCondition.description: Condition evaluated against one path. When multiple comparison operators are present, all of them must evaluate to true.

key.description: Property containing the value stored by the field.

label.description: Property containing the human-readable label presented to the user.

attributes.description: DOM attributes applied to the rendered component.

properties.description: DOM/Web Component properties applied directly to the rendered component.

meta.description: Compiler, source or diagnostic metadata ignored by normal rendering.
